## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Preserve following options when JSON has no path — `['--json', '--junit', 'report.xml']` raises `ValueError('unknown option: report.xml')` instead of selecting both reports. The JSON branch consumes `--junit` as its destination because it only checks whether another token exists. — Users requesting default JSON output before a JUnit destination receive a parsing error, and neither report is written. — Fix: Check for an option prefix before consuming JSON’s optional path, and extend `test_json_default_and_explicit_path`.
